gloss: to add a remark; to say in addition

definitions.gloss: to add a remark; to say in addition
definitions.explanation: To tack a short extra comment onto what one has just said, often a qualification, a reassurance, or a polite afterthought. The added remark is typically brief.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧{言|い}い{添|そ}えた。
「⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧はしないで」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言|い}い{添|そ}えた。

⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦あくまで→あくまで：06713_akumade⟧⟦{現時点|げんじてん}→現時点：13556_genjiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{添|そ}えた。
examples.english: At the end of his explanation, he added, "This is only the plan as of now."

notes:
A compound of ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say) and ⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧ (to attach, to accompany). Slightly literary; very common in narration and news writing to introduce a speaker's closing remark.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the words added, or a quoted remark with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧{言|い}い{添|そ}える: to add a word
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{添|そ}える: to add, "~"
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{言|い}い{添|そ}える: to add at the end

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える→付け加える：11520_tsukekuwaeru⟧: to add — broader; works for information, conditions, or objects, not just speech
- ⟦{付|つ}け{足|た}す→付け足す：06863_tsuketasu⟧: to tack on — plainer and more casual
